work_or_witness: FABULA ULTIMA TTJRPG Core Rulebook · Core overview: Create your own setting together
definition: The core game's procedure in which a group freely shapes its own world, including kingdoms, villages, historical events, and inhabitants.
cultural_caution: A table-authorship procedure, not a canonical world history or a claim about a real culture, state, community, or historical event. Campaign-created setting facts remain table-specific.

citations.locator: Core overview: Create your own setting together
supports: NEED GAMES! says the group can freely shape its own world and its people/history.

work_or_witness: FABULA ULTIMA TTJRPG Core Rulebook · Core overview: Fifteen Classes to mix and match
definition: The core book's fifteen mix-and-match modular character-growth options for creating heroes.
cultural_caution: A player-build mechanic, not a social class, occupation, real identity, or canonically fixed category for every hero. Later Atlas classes remain outside this core pass.

citations.locator: Core overview: Fifteen Classes to mix and match
supports: NEED GAMES! identifies fifteen modular classes for designing player heroes.

work_or_witness: FABULA ULTIMA TTJRPG Core Rulebook · Core overview: Game Master tools and Villains
definition: The Game Master-facing system category for bringing the heroes' dark mirrors into adventures.
cultural_caution: A source-specific narrative/game category, not a moral diagnosis of real people or evidence that a named figure in a table-created story has a permanent canonical role.

citations.locator: Core overview: Game Master tools and Villains
supports: NEED GAMES! describes Villains as heroes' dark mirrors in Game Master tools.

work_or_witness: FABULA ULTIMA Third-Party License Style Guide · Terminology table: Fabula Points, Ultima Points
definition: Capitalized core-rule point resources that official English terminology says may be gained, lost, or spent.
cultural_caution: Game resources only. They are not currency, moral worth, fate, or a franchise-equivalence claim, and should not be used to infer a named character's narrative history without direct evidence.

citations.locator: Terminology table: Fabula Points, Ultima Points
supports: Official style guide states that Fabula Points and Ultima Points can be gained, lost, or spent.

work_or_witness: FABULA ULTIMA TTJRPG Core Rulebook · Core overview opening and ruleset description
definition: The publisher's description of the core game as inspired by Japanese-style console RPGs and designed to evoke their gameplay and atmosphere.
cultural_caution: A broad genre influence, not a claim of identity with any videogame, Japanese culture, Japanese people, or named franchise. Do not import characters, settings, plots, art, or mechanics from source videogames.

citations.locator: Core overview opening and ruleset description
supports: NEED GAMES! calls Fabula Ultima a tabletop RPG inspired by Japanese-style console RPGs/JRPGs.
